summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit press release announcing the date of its annual general meeting and the nomination of a new director, Paul Dadwal, who will replace Scott Larson. Mr. Larson stepped down as a director. No terms, prices, or transaction details are provided. This is a routine management information circular and AGM notice, not a special situation. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, and the board changes are normal turnover. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special event to classify. The press release contains forward-looking statements about the meeting and election.
